comment: Turns the one-page checkout flow on or off for the storefront.
modal: Controls whether customers check out through Magento's single-page checkout. Set to **No** to disable it (for example when a custom checkout replaces it).

comment: Lets shoppers place an order without creating or signing into an account.
modal: When **Yes**, customers can check out as a guest. When **No**, they must register or sign in before they can place an order.

comment: Whether the billing address is collected on the payment step or on its own checkout page.
modal: Chooses where the billing address is asked for: on the **Payment Method** step, or on a separate **Payment Page**.

comment: How many line items the order summary lists before the rest are collapsed.
modal: The number of items shown in the checkout order summary; any beyond this are hidden behind a toggle to keep the summary short.

comment: How many days an inactive cart (quote) is kept before it is cleared.
modal: The lifetime, in days, of an abandoned shopping cart. After this period the quote is eligible to be removed by the clean-up process.

comment: Whether adding a product sends the shopper straight to the cart or leaves them on the page.
modal: When **Yes**, adding a product redirects to the shopping cart page. When **No**, the shopper stays where they are (typically with a mini-cart update).

comment: Number of cart line items shown per page before pagination appears.
modal: How many items the shopping cart lists on one page; once the cart holds more, a pager is shown.

comment: Whether cross-sell product suggestions are shown on the shopping cart page.
modal: Controls the display of cross-sell ("you might also like") products on the cart page.

comment: Whether an "empty cart" button is shown on the shopping cart page.
modal: When **Yes**, customers get a button to clear the whole cart in one action.

comment: Whether the cart link counts distinct items or total item quantity.
modal: Chooses what the header cart summary counts: the number of distinct items in the cart, or the total quantity across all items.

comment: Whether the mini-cart dropdown is shown in the page header.
modal: Controls the header mini-cart. Set to **No** to hide the dropdown cart preview.

comment: How many of the most recent items the mini-cart shows before it scrolls.
modal: The number of items visible in the mini-cart before its list becomes scrollable.

comment: Maximum number of items the mini-cart will list.
modal: An upper bound on how many items the mini-cart renders, regardless of cart size, to keep the dropdown manageable.

comment: Which store email identity the "payment failed" notification is sent from.
modal: The sender identity for payment-failure emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2).

comment: Which store email identity receives the "payment failed" notification.
modal: The internal recipient of payment-failure emails, chosen from the configured **Store Email Addresses** identities.

comment: How copies of the payment-failed email are sent — blind copy or a separate email.
modal: Chooses how additional recipients receive the payment-failure notice: as a **Bcc** on the original email, or as a **Separate Email**.
